title: Hidden reaction pathways inform additive engineering for perovskite LEDs
title_zh: 隐藏的反应路径信息指向钙钛矿LED的添加剂工程
abstract: Perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) have emerged as a promising class of solution-processed light-emitting devices, combining high efficiency with facile fabrication1–5. Amino-acid-based molecular additives are widely used to regulate crystallization and suppress defects in perovskite thin films6–8, yet these molecules are chemically reactive in precursor solutions, in which their transformations and products remain poorly understood. Here we resolve and control the hidden solution-phase chemistry of a ubiquitous additive, 5-aminovaleric acid (5AVA), whose solution-phase reactivity has remained unclear6,9–15. We show that 5AVA undergoes competing in situ reactions during precursor preconditioning, yielding two chemically and functionally distinct products: a beneficial organoamidinium zwitterion and a detrimental Lewis-base lactam. By explaining this reaction dichotomy and establishing targeted reaction-pathway control, we selectively use the beneficial species. Direct synthesis and incorporation of the purified zwitterion decouple its intrinsic passivation function from confounding by-products, yielding perovskite films with a near-unity mean peak photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 97.2% and PeLEDs with a champion external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 37.1%, alongside a mean peak EQE of 32.8%. Finally, we demonstrate that this reaction-pathway control concept can be extended to further additive chemistries and emission colours, highlighting its potential as a chemistry-driven strategy for rational additive design in PeLEDs. Resolution and control of the hidden solution-phase chemistry of 5-aminovaleric acid added to perovskite precursor solutions is described for producing films with a near-unity mean peak photoluminescence quantum yield and near-infrared perovskite LEDs with enhanced external quantum efficiencies.
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿发光二极管（PeLED）作为一种有前景的溶液加工发光器件类型，结合了高效率和简便的制备工艺1–5。氨基酸分子添加剂广泛用于调控结晶和抑制钙钛矿薄膜中的缺陷6–8，然而这些分子在前驱体溶液中具有化学反应性，其转化产物仍知之甚少。本研究阐明了一种常用添加剂5-氨基戊酸（5AVA）在溶液相中的隐藏化学反应性，此前其反应路径尚不清楚6,9–15。我们发现，在前驱体预处理过程中，5AVA会发生竞争性的原位反应，生成两种化学性质和功能截然不同的产物：一种有益的有机 amidonium 杂维离子和一种有害的路易斯碱乳酰胺。通过阐明这种反应二律背反并建立有针对性的反应路径控制，我们选择性地利用有益的物种。直接合成并掺入纯化的杂维离子，将其内在的表面被动化功能与干扰性副产物解耦，得到峰值光致发光量子产率（PLQY）接近 unity（均值97.2%）的钙钛矿薄膜，以及外量子效率（EQE）峰值37.1%（冠军器件）和均值峰值EQE 32.8%。最后，我们展示了这种反应路径控制概念可进一步扩展到其他添加剂化学体系和发光颜色，突显了其作为钙钛矿LED rational additive design（合理添加剂设计）化学驱动策略的潜力。阐明了5-氨基戊酸在钙钛矿前驱体溶液中隐藏的溶液相化学反应，从而生产出峰值光致发光量子产率接近 unity 的薄膜，并制造出外量子效率增强的近红外钙钛矿LED。
